quests.instruction: Mia starts a road trip at 10:30 AM. After 2 hours and 15 minutes, what time is it?
quests.question: 12:45 PM
quests.hint: Add the hours in 2 hours and 15 minutes first, then add the minutes, starting from 10:30 AM.
quests.explanation: Adding 2 hours and 15 minutes to 10:30 AM carries the clock all the way around to 12:45 PM.
quests.funFact: Adding the hours first and then the minutes makes two-step problems easier.

quests.instruction: Which time is the same as quarter to six in the evening?
quests.question: 5:45 PM
quests.hint: For "quarter to six": quarter to means minutes before the hour, quarter past means minutes after it.
quests.explanation: 5:45 PM is the digital match for that spoken time.
quests.funFact: Quarter to six means fifteen minutes remain before six o'clock arrives.

quests.instruction: The overnight train arrives at 6:15 AM after a 7 hour and 30 minute journey. What time did it depart?
quests.question: 10:45 PM
quests.hint: Starting at 6:15 AM, count 7 hours and 30 minutes backward one part at a time.
quests.explanation: Subtracting 7 hours and 30 minutes from 6:15 AM lands exactly on 10:45 PM.
quests.funFact: Overnight train journeys often begin the evening before they arrive.

quests.instruction: Which time is earliest: 11:50 PM, 12:10 AM, or 11:30 PM?
quests.question: 11:50 PM
quests.hint: Look closely at 11:50 PM, 12:10 AM, 11:30 PM — remember that midnight flips PM into AM.
quests.explanation: 11:50 PM is the earliest, coming before both 12:10 AM and 11:30 PM.
quests.funFact: Once midnight passes, a 12:10 AM time actually belongs to the NEXT day.

quests.instruction: It is 10:40 PM. What time will it be in 3 hours and 15 minutes?
quests.question: 1:55 AM
quests.hint: Add the hours in 3 hours and 15 minutes first, then add the minutes, starting from 10:40 PM.
quests.explanation: 3 hours and 15 minutes after 10:40 PM is 1:55 AM, after rolling over into a new half of the day.
quests.funFact: Late-night additions like this one often cross right over midnight.

quests.instruction: Leo's train leaves at 9:45 AM and the ride takes 3 hours and 20 minutes. What time does it arrive?
quests.question: 1:05 PM
quests.hint: Break 3 hours and 20 minutes into two steps: add the hours, then the minutes, from 9:45 AM.
quests.explanation: Adding 3 hours and 20 minutes to 9:45 AM rolls past the halfway point of the day, landing on 1:05 PM for Leo.
quests.funFact: Long train rides often take a few hours to reach a new city.

quests.instruction: Which time is the same as quarter past eight in the morning?
quests.question: 8:15 AM
quests.hint: Break "quarter past eight" into the hour word and the quarter word separately.
quests.explanation: Written as a digital time, that phrase becomes 8:15 AM.
quests.funFact: Quarter past eight means fifteen minutes have passed since eight o'clock.

quests.instruction: The bake sale is ready at 1:00 PM after 2 hours and 45 minutes of baking. What time did baking begin?
quests.question: 10:15 AM
quests.hint: Break 2 hours and 45 minutes into two steps: subtract the hours, then the minutes, from 1:00 PM.
quests.explanation: 2 hours and 45 minutes before 1:00 PM is 10:15 AM.
quests.funFact: Baking a big batch of treats can take a few hours from start to finish.

quests.instruction: Which time is latest: 12:05 AM, 11:55 PM, or 11:40 PM?
quests.question: 12:05 AM
quests.hint: Line up 12:05 AM, 11:55 PM, 11:40 PM in the order a clock would tick through them.
quests.explanation: Since 12:05 AM happens last on the clock, it is later than 11:55 PM and 11:40 PM.
quests.funFact: A time just after midnight is technically later than any time the night before.

quests.instruction: It is 6:50 AM. What time will it be in 5 hours and 25 minutes?
quests.question: 12:15 PM
quests.hint: Break 5 hours and 25 minutes into two steps: add the hours, then the minutes, from 6:50 AM.
quests.explanation: Adding 5 hours and 25 minutes to 6:50 AM carries the clock all the way around to 12:15 PM.
quests.funFact: Morning additions like this one can carry you past noon into the afternoon.

quests.instruction: Ava falls asleep at 11:00 PM. If she sleeps for 2 hours before stirring, what time is it?
quests.question: 1:00 AM
quests.hint: Starting at 11:00 PM, count 2 hours forward one part at a time.
quests.explanation: 2 hours after 11:00 PM is 1:00 AM, after rolling over into a new half of the day.
quests.funFact: Crossing midnight means the clock rolls from PM all the way back to AM.

quests.instruction: Which time is the same as quarter to twelve in the late morning?
quests.question: 11:45 AM
quests.hint: Turn "quarter to twelve" into a digital time one small piece at a time.
quests.explanation: That wording matches 11:45 AM on a digital clock.
quests.funFact: Quarter to twelve means fifteen minutes remain before noon arrives.

quests.instruction: Recess ends at 9:30 AM after the class worked for 1 hour and 50 minutes straight. What time did class begin?
quests.question: 7:40 AM
quests.hint: Subtract the hours in 1 hour and 50 minutes first, then subtract the minutes, from 9:30 AM.
quests.explanation: Going back 1 hour and 50 minutes from 9:30 AM gives 7:40 AM.
quests.funFact: Almost two hours of steady class time can fly by when a lesson is fun.

quests.instruction: Which time is latest: 11:58 PM, 12:02 AM, or 11:45 PM?
quests.question: 11:58 PM
quests.hint: Among 11:58 PM, 12:02 AM, 11:45 PM, watch for which times are just before or just after midnight.
quests.explanation: 11:58 PM is the latest, coming after both 12:02 AM and 11:45 PM.
quests.funFact: 11:58 PM is the very last moment of one day, just before midnight strikes.

quests.instruction: It is 2:35 PM. What time will it be in 2 hours and 40 minutes?
quests.question: 5:15 PM
quests.hint: Starting at 2:35 PM, count 2 hours and 40 minutes forward one part at a time.
quests.explanation: Adding 2 hours and 40 minutes to 2:35 PM lands exactly on 5:15 PM.
quests.funFact: Adding hours and minutes separately keeps two-step problems simple.

quests.instruction: The overnight campfire starts at 9:00 PM and burns for 3 hours and 30 minutes. What time does it burn out?
quests.question: 12:30 AM
quests.hint: Watch closely — adding 3 hours and 30 minutes to 9:00 PM rolls over into a new half of the day.
quests.explanation: Adding 3 hours and 30 minutes to 9:00 PM carries the clock all the way around to 12:30 AM.
quests.funFact: A crackling campfire can burn for hours under a starry sky.

quests.instruction: Which time is the same as quarter to three in the afternoon?
quests.question: 2:45 PM
quests.hint: For "quarter to three": quarter to means minutes before the hour, quarter past means minutes after it.
quests.explanation: 2:45 PM is the digital match for that spoken time.
quests.funFact: Quarter to three means fifteen minutes remain before three o'clock arrives.

quests.instruction: The stargazing club packs up at 12:20 AM after watching the sky for 3 hours and 40 minutes. What time did they start?
quests.question: 8:40 PM
quests.hint: Starting at 12:20 AM, count 3 hours and 40 minutes backward one part at a time.
quests.explanation: Subtracting 3 hours and 40 minutes from 12:20 AM lands exactly on 8:40 PM.
quests.funFact: Stargazing after dark can stretch on for hours under a clear sky.

quests.instruction: Which time is earliest: 12:01 AM, 11:59 PM, or 11:30 PM?
quests.question: 12:01 AM
quests.hint: Look closely at 12:01 AM, 11:59 PM, 11:30 PM — remember that midnight flips PM into AM.
quests.explanation: Since 12:01 AM happens first on the clock, it is earlier than 11:59 PM and 11:30 PM.
quests.funFact: 12:01 AM belongs to a brand-new day that has only just begun.

quests.instruction: It is 11:25 AM. What time will it be in 1 hour and 50 minutes?
quests.question: 1:15 PM
quests.hint: Watch closely — adding 1 hour and 50 minutes to 11:25 AM rolls over into a new half of the day.
quests.explanation: 1 hour and 50 minutes after 11:25 AM is 1:15 PM, after rolling over into a new half of the day.
quests.funFact: Adding just under two hours to a late-morning time often lands in the afternoon.

quests.instruction: Sam's science experiment begins at 1:15 PM and takes 1 hour and 40 minutes. What time does it finish?
quests.question: 2:55 PM
quests.hint: Starting at 1:15 PM, count 1 hour and 40 minutes forward one part at a time.
quests.explanation: Adding 1 hour and 40 minutes to 1:15 PM lands exactly on 2:55 PM for Sam.
quests.funFact: Careful experiments often take more than an hour to complete.

quests.instruction: Which time is the same as quarter past six in the early morning?
quests.question: 6:15 AM
quests.hint: Break "quarter past six" into the hour word and the quarter word separately.
quests.explanation: Written as a digital time, that phrase becomes 6:15 AM.
quests.funFact: Quarter past six means fifteen minutes have passed since six o'clock.

quests.instruction: The school carnival wraps up at 2:10 PM after running for 4 hours and 15 minutes. What time did it start?
quests.question: 9:55 AM
quests.hint: Break 4 hours and 15 minutes into two steps: subtract the hours, then the minutes, from 2:10 PM.
quests.explanation: 4 hours and 15 minutes before 2:10 PM is 9:55 AM.
quests.funFact: A carnival that runs over four hours gives everyone plenty of time to visit each booth.

quests.instruction: Which time is earliest: 11:40 AM, 12:05 PM, or 12:15 PM?
quests.question: 11:40 AM
quests.hint: Line up 11:40 AM, 12:05 PM, 12:15 PM in the order a clock would tick through them.
quests.explanation: 11:40 AM is the earliest, coming before both 12:05 PM and 12:15 PM.
quests.funFact: Any AM time, even close to noon, still comes before every PM time that day.

quests.instruction: It is 9:15 PM. What time will it be in 4 hours and 20 minutes?
quests.question: 1:35 AM
quests.hint: Add the hours in 4 hours and 20 minutes first, then add the minutes, starting from 9:15 PM.
quests.explanation: Adding 4 hours and 20 minutes to 9:15 PM carries the clock all the way around to 1:35 AM.
quests.funFact: Adding several hours to a nighttime start often crosses into the very early morning.

quests.instruction: Zoe's overnight flight takes off at 10:00 PM and lasts 4 hours. What time does it land?
quests.question: 2:00 AM
quests.hint: Break 4 hours into two steps: add the hours, then the minutes, from 10:00 PM.
quests.explanation: 4 hours after 10:00 PM is 2:00 AM, after rolling over into a new half of the day for Zoe.
quests.funFact: Overnight flights often land in the very early hours of the morning.

quests.instruction: Which time is the same as quarter to ten at night?
quests.question: 9:45 PM
quests.hint: Turn "quarter to ten" into a digital time one small piece at a time.
quests.explanation: That wording matches 9:45 PM on a digital clock.
quests.funFact: Quarter to ten means fifteen minutes remain before ten o'clock arrives.

quests.instruction: The birthday movie night ends at 11:05 PM after 2 hours and 20 minutes of movies and snacks. What time did it start?
quests.question: 8:45 PM
quests.hint: Subtract the hours in 2 hours and 20 minutes first, then subtract the minutes, from 11:05 PM.
quests.explanation: Going back 2 hours and 20 minutes from 11:05 PM gives 8:45 PM.
quests.funFact: Movie nights with popcorn breaks can run a bit longer than the movie itself.

quests.instruction: Which time is latest: 12:10 PM, 11:55 AM, or 12:00 PM?
quests.question: 12:10 PM
quests.hint: Among 12:10 PM, 11:55 AM, 12:00 PM, watch for which times are just before or just after midnight.
quests.explanation: Since 12:10 PM happens last on the clock, it is later than 11:55 AM and 12:00 PM.
quests.funFact: 12:10 PM comes just a little after noon, making it the latest of these three.

quests.instruction: It is 7:45 AM. What time will it be in 6 hours and 10 minutes?
quests.question: 1:55 PM
quests.hint: Break 6 hours and 10 minutes into two steps: add the hours, then the minutes, from 7:45 AM.
quests.explanation: Adding 6 hours and 10 minutes to 7:45 AM rolls past the halfway point of the day, landing on 1:55 PM.
quests.funFact: Six hours from a morning start usually lands in the afternoon.
